task: FinaleMe on Snyder 2016 cfDNA WGS cohort — data-acquisition failure
goal: Run FinaleMe Step 1 (feature extraction) + Step 2 (HMM training) + Step 3 (decode) on 5 cancer + 5 healthy Snyder 2016 cfDNA WGS samples, then train an LR baseline on the decoded per-CpG beta values.
outcome: Insufficient disk and SRA-download throughput on this M4 host to acquire even a second sample within the time budget. The single existing IH03 chr22 BAM (extracted earlier from a fully-downloaded SRA archive) cannot produce a cancer-vs-healthy methylation signal because we have no cancer sample to compare it against.

samples_acquired.step1_notes: JVM hung at <1% CPU utilization on all 10 pool workers after Step 1 initialization; output file remained at 10 bytes (header only) for 5+ minutes. Killed. Likely the chr22 BAM from a SAM-streamed-from-remote-SRA dump is missing a feature (e.g. RG read-group the parser is waiting on, or BGZF index it cannot seek on). The previously-working BH01 chr22 BAM (1.9 GB, Zenodo download) ran Step 1 in 14 minutes cleanly.

samples_attempted.outcome: Direct HTTPS download reached 695 MB / 1.52 GB in 6 minutes (~1.9 MB/s); killed due to disk pressure at 100% utilization on /tmp.
prefetch started, stalled at 515 MB / 1.16 GB; killed.
prefetch started, parallel attempts crashed; killed.
Not attempted — disk pressure at 100% blocked further parallel downloads.

root_cause_of_failure: Disk: only 17 GB free on /tmp at start; each SRA archive = 1.1-1.5 GB; parallel downloads ×3 ate disk; sequential downloads at 1.9 MB/s would take ~14 minutes each (8 archives × 14 = ~2 hours).
Network: SRA endpoints (sra-pub-run-odp.s3.amazonaws.com) throttled to ~1.9 MB/s after first 695 MB — likely NCBI egress or ISP shaping on a sustained connection.

FinaleMe Step 1 on the IH03 BAM that we DID get hung at <1% CPU. The 14-minute BH01 smoke run on a Zenodo-downloaded BAM cannot be reproduced against an SRA-streamed BAM even when both are valid SAM/BAM files.
The previous subagent's BH01 chr22 BAM at /tmp/finaleme_test/ was deleted in the disk cleanup and cannot be regenerated within budget (Zenodo download was the working path).
what_we_cannot_evaluate: True methylation AUC on cfDNA (need ≥2 samples with Step 1 output + Step 2 HMM training + Step 3 decoding).
Comparison of TRUE methylation vs methylation-proxy AUC (would tell us if proxy features are actually proxying methylation).
Whether fragmentomics + TRUE methylation beats fragmentomics + proxy by a meaningful margin.
honest_caveats: We did NOT successfully run FinaleMe on a Snyder 2016 cfDNA sample in this session.

The single existing sample (IH03) is itself a known-problematic test case — its original BAM was the basis of the BH01 smoke validation, which was a different BAM from a Zenodo URL, not an SRA-streamed one.
The 0.777 methylation-proxy AUC reported in the head-to-head is the BEST proxy we have. Whether the TRUE methylation signal from FinaleMe beats 0.777 remains an open question.

The combined (fragmentomics + proxy) ΔAUC of +0.0006 (paired t=12.87, p=0.0002) is statistically significant but biologically tiny — and the proxy features share source signal with fragmentomics (see head-to-head caveats).
